rolledBack.title: Deploy rolled back — {app}
rolledBack.summary: New version of {app} failed its health check; the previous version is still live.

halted.title: Rollout halted — {name}
halted.summary: The fleet rollout {name} halted in wave {wave} of {waves}: {reason}.

completed.title: Rollout completed — {name}
completed.summary: The fleet rollout {name} reached all {waves} waves; {passed} of {total} apps are on the new version.

rolledBack.title: Rollout rolled back — {name}
rolledBack.summary: The fleet rollback of {name} reverted {reverted} app(s) to their previous version; {skipped} left untouched (never moved, or deployed again since).

rollbackFailed.title: Rollout rollback FAILED — {name}
rollbackFailed.summary: The fleet rollback of {name} could not revert {failed} app(s); check them now.

reason.wave_failed: a wave had more failures than allowed
reason.wave_no_signal: a wave produced no successful deploy
reason.bake_failed: an app failed its observation window
reason.interrupted: the hub restarted during a deploy

completed.title: App moved — {app}
completed.summary: {app} now runs on {target}. The stopped copy of its data on {source} is kept until {until}.

rolledBack.title: App move rolled back — {app}
rolledBack.summary: Moving {app} to {target} did not finish: {reason}. {app} is running on {source} again.

failed.title: App move FAILED — {app}
failed.summary: Moving {app} to {target} failed ({reason}) and {app} could not be brought back up on {source}. Next step: open the app, read the move's log, fix the old server by hand, then purge the move.

reason.preflight_changed: the situation changed after the move was planned (re-run the preflight)
reason.stop_failed: the app could not be stopped on the old server
reason.stop_unverified: the app was still running on the old server after the stop
reason.prepare_failed: the new server could not be prepared
reason.pack_failed: the volume could not be packed on the old server
reason.part_stat_failed: a transfer part could not be measured
reason.transfer_failed: a part of the data could not be transferred
reason.size_mismatch: a transferred part had the wrong size
reason.sha_mismatch: a transferred part failed its checksum
reason.apply_aborted: the data could not be unpacked on the new server (nothing was changed there)
reason.apply_rolled_back: unpacking the data failed and was rolled back on the new server
reason.apply_rollback_failed: unpacking the data failed and its rollback failed on the new server
reason.apply_failed: unpacking the data failed on the new server
reason.entry_count_mismatch: the unpacked data did not match the original
reason.changed_under_us: the app was changed by someone else during the move
reason.cutover_failed: switching the app to the new server failed
reason.deploy_failed: the app failed to start on the new server
reason.deploy_timeout: the app did not become healthy on the new server in time
reason.hub_restarted: the hub restarted during the move
reason.deadline_exceeded: the move took too long and a server stayed offline
reason.source_restart_failed: the app could not be restarted on the old server

missing.title: No recent backup — {name}
missing.summary: {name} has had no successful backup in the last {hours} hours — its backup schedule may have stopped.
missing.volumeSummary: {name} has had no successful volume backup in the last {hours} hours — its backup schedule may have stopped.

recovered.title: Backups recovered — {name}
recovered.after_failed: A backup of {name} succeeded again after a failure.
recovered.after_missing: A backup of {name} succeeded again after a stretch with no successful backup.

missing.title: Restore-verify stalled — {name}
missing.summary: {name} has run no restore-verify drill in the last {hours} hours — its verify schedule may have stopped.

recovered.title: Restore-verify recovered — {name}
recovered.after_failed: A restore-verify drill for {name} succeeded again after a failure.
recovered.after_missing: A restore-verify drill for {name} ran again after a stretch with none.

verified.title: Reboot verified — {server}
verified.summary: {server} rebooted and everything came back: {containersOk} of {containersTotal} containers running, {domainsOk} of {domainsTotal} domains answering.

degraded.title: Reboot finished with problems — {server}
degraded.summary: {server} rebooted, but not everything came back: {containersOk} of {containersTotal} containers running, {domainsOk} of {domainsTotal} domains answering. Open the server to see which.

failed.title: Reboot FAILED — {server}
failed.summary: The reboot of {server} did not complete: {reason}. Next step: open the server and check it.

reason.snapshot_failed: Tugra could not read what was running, so nothing was rebooted
reason.start_failed: the reboot could not be armed on the server
reason.interrupted: the hub was interrupted before the reboot started
reason.agent_never_returned: the server's agent did not come back in time
reason.state_unreadable: the server could not be read after the reboot
reason.missed: the scheduled time passed while the hub could not start it, so it was not run
reason.unauthorized: whoever scheduled it can no longer run server operations on this team

serverReboot.stillRequired: the server still asks for a reboot

degraded.title: Swarm degraded — {cluster}
degraded.summary: Cluster {cluster}'s Docker Swarm dropped from healthy to degraded — a node may be unreachable.

oom.title: Container out of memory — {container}
oom.summary: {container} was killed by the kernel for exceeding its memory limit (OOM).

unhealthy.title: Container unhealthy — {container}
unhealthy.summary: {container}'s healthcheck is failing — it is reporting unhealthy (the process is up but not serving correctly).

memPressure.title: Container nearing its memory limit — {container}
memPressure.summary: {container} has been using {pct}% of its {limit} MB memory limit — it may be OOM-killed soon.

ssl.title: SSL certificate expiring — {domain}
ssl.summary: The TLS certificate for {domain} expires in {days} day(s).

imageUpdate.title: Image update available for {app}
imageUpdate.summary: A newer image for {image} is available upstream than the one deployed.
